issue: Acme::Storage::Local.fetch reads blobs by key; a key of ../../../etc/hostname returns host files. Locate the read implementation.

source_files.content:
module Acme
  module Storage
    module Local
      ROOT = "/var/lib/acme/blobs"

      def self.store(key, data)
        File.binwrite(File.join(ROOT, key.tr("/", "_")), data)
      end

      def self.fetch(key)
        File.binread(File.join(ROOT, key))
      end
    end
  end
end
